description: Two adaptive levels with subcycling (G 7 1) and the test of the placement (G 40 2): small units placed anew at every regrid on the least loaded rank, so the coarser level and the old patches are mostly on the other rank.
covers: regrid_old: new patches from old patches of the other rank
level-2 patches cut at the units, units with an edge of level 2 on their common face on one rank
the level projection and the synchronisation through the shadows
